description: Execute a single SQL statement and return the result rows. In read-only connections only SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN/WITH statements are allowed. On writable connections each write type (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL) is gated by its own permission flag and runs only when enabled. Use `params` with ? placeholders for values (strongly recommended — prevents SQL injection); the server binds them via the native driver. Multi-statement SQL is rejected. Results are capped at the configured max rows.

connection.description: Connection name. Omit when only one is configured.

maxRows.description: Per-call row limit. Values above the connection maximum are clamped, never honoured.

params.description: Positional values bound to ? placeholders in sql (left to right). Prefer this over interpolating values into the SQL text. Number of values must match the number of ? placeholders.

sql.description: The SQL statement to execute. One statement only. Use ? for bind placeholders.

name: execute_sql
title: Execute SQL
